headline: Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts reported for Claude AI
summary: An Anthropic Claude user reported their enterprise AI agent unexpectedly discussing Minecraft, suggesting a potential cross-session data leak. This raises concerns about the isolation of sensitive chat sessions.
details: A user of Anthropic's Claude AI, operating within an Enterprise ZDR workspace, observed their agent unexpectedly asking about Minecraft bricks and asserting it was building a Minecraft temple. This behavior occurred despite the session being authenticated to a specific enterprise environment.

The user highlighted concerns that this incident points to a potential session or cache leakage. This could mean data is not properly isolated between workspace instances or even consumer accounts, raising serious questions about the security of sensitive chat sessions.

While the user acknowledged a "weird" personal setup involving different working directories, they noted this was distinct from the unexpected Minecraft prompt. The core issue appears to be an external data bleed, not a self-inflicted context mix-up.
